description: I am Equi, a developer and illustrator.I help companies and creators design reliable, polished, and visually distinctive digital experiences.As a developer, I design functional and intuitive interfaces, with a particular focus on performance, code clarity, and user experience. My approach is pragmatic: understand needs, propose solid solutions, and deliver a clean, maintainable, and effective result.In illustration, I create visuals tailored to brand identities, creative projects, and narrative worlds. My work combines technical precision, attention to detail, and the ability to produce images that truly support a message or mood.I am particularly drawn to projects that require both technical rigor and artistic direction.My goal: to offer comprehensive, consistent, and high-value-added solutions.
